suppress.notes: AndroidX Browser is a support library, not the legacy Android platform browser affected by CVE-2008-7298.
AndroidX SQLite uses its own library release version. Dependency-Check must not interpret that AndroidX version as the embedded SQLite engine version when matching sqlite:sqlite CPEs.
libvlc-all is VideoLAN LibVLC, not the Drupal Video module represented by video_project:video.
Coil's Android video extension is not the Drupal Video module represented by video_project:video.
These Maven artifacts are not GitHub Enterprise; their group names merely contain "github".
libsu-service is not the unrelated generic service_project:service product.
eu.agno3.jcifs:jcifs-ng is a Java SMB/CIFS library. CVE-2026-35002 applies to the unrelated Python Agno AI framework (agno-agi/agno), not jcifs-ng.
CVE-2026-53914 concerns unsafe deserialization in Kotlin build-cache metadata. These artifacts are shipped Kotlin runtime libraries and do not implement that build-cache path.
CVE-2020-29582 was fixed in Kotlin 1.4.21. NVD's current broad Kotlin CPE range overmatches the 1.8.22 JDK compatibility artifacts that are present on the Android runtime classpath.
